aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 10-year-old boy in white tennis kit, racket beside him
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting on a clinic chair, one shoe off
signs: right ankle visibly swollen and red
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 10-year-old boy who looks his age (lean and athletic), in a white tennis outfit with a white wrist sweatband, a tennis racket propped beside him, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with arms crossed, one shoe off. Expression: an annoyed, cocky brave-face wince - one eye squinted shut, brow furrowed, mouth in a gritted half-grimace showing a bit of teeth, a tough kid toughing it out (NOT crying, NOT a soft happy smile). Clearly visible: a localized red, inflamed swelling ONLY around the right ankle joint - a red puffy patch right at the ankle bone, with the rest of the bare foot, toes, and leg a normal skin tone (bare foot, no sock, no bandage). No text, no logos.
